policy: Only results supplied or confirmed by the academy are published here.
Student names appear only when the academy has supplied them. Otherwise the record says “TEMS student” or “TEMS delegation”.
Years are shown only when confirmed. Records without a confirmed year sit in the undated section.
Photographs are used with the academy’s permission and captioned as supplied.
